async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Step 1: Search for the project 'kkroening/ffmpeg-python' using the searchbox
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name')
    await searchbox.fill('kkroening/ffmpeg-python')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for search results to load
    
    # Step 2: Click the project link to navigate to its details
    # Look for a link with the exact project name in the search results
    project_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='kkroening/ffmpeg-python', exact=True)
    await project_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 3: Navigate to settings or members page
    try:
        settings_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Settings', exact=True)
        await settings_link.click()
    except Exception:
        members_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Members', exact=True)
        await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 4: Click 'Invite members' button
    invite_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Invite members', exact=True)
    await invite_button.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Wait for UI to update
    
    # Step 5: Fill in user names
    user_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search users')
    for user in ['yjlou', 'a11yproject']:
        await user_input.fill(user)
        await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        try:
            user_option = page.get_by_role('option', name=user, exact=True)
            await user_option.click()
        except Exception:
            pass  # Assume user is auto-selected
    
    # Step 6: Set role to 'Maintainer'
    role_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Role')
    await role_combobox.click()
    maintainer_option = page.get_by_role('option', name='Maintainer', exact=True)
    await maintainer_option.click()
    
    # Step 7: Add users to project
    add_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Add to project', exact=True)
    await add_button.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for action to complete
